scoring.normalization: linear between worst (0) and best (100), clamped
scoring.aggregation: weighted mean of normalized KPI scores

kpis.name: Cycle Time
kpis.definition: Median elapsed time from request to decision.

kpis.name: Queue Wait
kpis.definition: Median time an item waits before work starts.

kpis.name: Touch Count
kpis.definition: Number of human touches per completed request.

kpis.name: Form Fields
kpis.definition: Required fields a requester must fill.

kpis.name: Automation Rate
kpis.definition: Share of requests completed without human intervention.

kpis.name: Straight-Through Processing
kpis.definition: Share of requests approved on first pass with no rework.

kpis.name: Duplicate Data Entry
kpis.definition: Share of fields entered more than once across a request.

kpis.name: Redundant Approvals
kpis.definition: Approval steps that repeat a prior decision.

kpis.name: Rework Rate
kpis.definition: Share of requests returned for correction.

kpis.name: Handoff Count
kpis.definition: Number of team handoffs per request.

kpis.name: Escalation Rate
kpis.definition: Share of requests escalated beyond first-line handling.

kpis.name: Status Enquiries
kpis.definition: Requester status-check messages per completed request.
